Definition: Jerubbesheth, a symbolic name for Gideon
BiblicalUsage: Jerubbesheth = "shame will contend"; 1) a variant name of Jerubbaal (the other name of Gideon [ H03378]) substituting the word 'shame' for the name of the pagan god 'Baal'
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
